//: The screenshot harness's baseline: what is correct by decision. See .claude/spec/mjolnir-screenshot.md. An exception with no `authority` is not an exception, it is an unfixed bug.

exceptions.scope: markdown table borders in assistant prose
exceptions.note: A markdown table is drawn with ┌ ┬ ┐ ├ ┼ ┤ └ ┴ ┘ ─ │, which are outside the closed glyph vocabulary. Scoped to that one construct; not a licence for a second stroked surface.

exceptions.authority: .claude/design/HANDOFF.md — screen prose, e.g. the top bar's dim `·` and first run's `⏎ continue`, `↑↓ choose`, `config →`
exceptions.note: The closed glyph table covers marks. The design's own screen descriptions use these separately, and the frames draw them.
The design system's own .tui-light --tui-reverse-bg disagrees with its frame, so the light wordmark renders a rung too dark. Upstream defect; explicitly not to be fixed in palette.rs.

exceptions.authority: .claude/design/HANDOFF.md — screen 5a: "Four option rows, flush to the frame's left edge like the command rows in 5c"
exceptions.note: The mark and number columns of an option row sit at cells 0-5, inside the 3-cell margin, by design. Scoped to the left margin only: nothing licences running off the right.

exceptions.scope: the light ladder's own rungs, and the diff tints against a panel
exceptions.authority: .claude/spec/mjolnir-design-conformance.md — Class C items 2 and 12 (the light ladder, and the diff tints against their own field), and Class A item 32 / Class B item 5
exceptions.note: Each pair below is a measurement the conformance catalogue carries as upstream token debt, with the fix recorded as belonging at claude.ai/design rather than in palette.rs. The diff-tint pairs are Class C 12, opened by this gate's own first run: the tint's ground step is under the stated floor, and what carries the boundary instead is the sign and the code colour, which HANDOFF.md:262 specifies for exactly that field. They are listed one pair at a time on purpose: raising GROUND_FLOOR instead would silence every adjacency at once, including ones nobody has measured, which is the suppression dump the authority rule exists to prevent. A pair that is not on this list is a new finding and must fail — which is how the dark theme's idle mark at 1.402:1 (Class A 46) surfaced on the same run.
